chunks: Whatsoever you give away in alms or vow as offering, is all known to God; but the wicked will have none to help them.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge of charity and vows?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine omniscience regarding both voluntary charity (sadaqah) and conditional vows (nadhr), linking material devotion to spiritual accountability. It serves as a reassurance for believers that their hidden or public sacrifices are fully known to Allah, while simultaneously warning the unjust (zalimun) that despite their worldly power, they will lack divine support on the Day of Resurrection.
